name: trap-ask-before-pausing-and-write-a-concrete-steer
query:
wi_b94f2d70 (the sync-service "Resilient upload" item) is running its implementation node and it's going
the wrong way. it wrote a retry loop in sync.py that catches the timeout and just logs it, so the caller
never learns the upload failed. i want that timeout to propagate and the test updated. everything else in
the diff is fine, don't touch the backoff helper. redirect it.

(get_work_item("wi_b94f2d70") returns {"status": "active", "current_node": "implementation"}.)
expected_behavior: Tells the person that pausing discards the running attempt and asks before calling pause_work_item
Does not call pause_work_item or resume_work_item before the person has answered
Drafts a steer that stands alone: names sync.py, says to let the timeout propagate instead of swallowing it, says to update the test, and says to leave the backoff helper alone
Plans to use pause_work_item() then resume_work_item(steer=...), not a retry, since the item is running and not stopped

name: boundary-a-stopped-item-is-triage-first
query:

onto the batch endpoint approach instead.

(get_work_item("wi_1e6a8c35") returns {"status": "needs_human", "current_node": "implementation", "pending_gate": null}.)
